params.script_inline:
import sys
# Terminal. Every outbound lane of a colony can end here -- an answer, a
# screened-off turn, a normalised error, a drained episode. Each of them is
# already in the message trace (open /ui/trace), so swallowing is exactly what
# keeps the dead-letter queue empty: a lane that ends nowhere dead-letters,
# a lane that ends HERE is a decision you have not made yet.
sys.stdout.write("[]")

description.purpose: The terminal of a colony: everything that leaves a tree arrives here and stops, so the trace shows it and nothing dead-letters.
description.use_when: As the placeholder for a decision not made yet -- where an answer goes, where a rejection is logged, where errors are alarmed, which memory a closed day belongs to.
description.not_in_scope: No storage, no forwarding, no judgement -- it is a stop, not a component.
